'''Fissrit''', also known as '''fire worms''', were a type of [[Diet/Legends|carnivorus]] [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropod]] with many [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. The could thrive in the [[Water/Legends|frozen]] conditions of the ice worlds they inhabited due to a natural chemical reaction that occurred in their underbellies that produced incredible [[Temperature/Legends|heat]]. When at rest, a fissrit produced only enough heat to survive local conditions, but the creatures were capable of increasing the temperature when needed.<ref name="Savage" />

Using the increased temperature, fissrit could melt snow or ice into a pool of liquid water. They could also then use that heat to [[Death/Legends|kill]] prey creatures that investigated the pool. All fissrit possessed a strong social instinct, with some varieties living in colonies, although the largest variants of fissrit tended to act as solitary hunters, with fissrit typically measuring just under a third of a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] in length. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], fissrit were hard to find for sale, but could be purchased for 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Savage" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fissrit were mentioned in the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' supplement ''[[Savage Spirits]]'', which was written by [[Tim Huckelberry]] and published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Savage" />
